|rulings=* This card is NOT a hologram.<ref name="scomp" />
* Global modifiers are applicable (e.g. [[Fondor]] reduces forfeit of Corvettes, [[Insurrection]] increases forfeit of Rebels).
* Cards forfeited from hand satisfy attrition, battle damage, or both as appropriate.
* Cards forfeited from hand must go to Lost Pile regardless of other game text (e.g. a character could not go to [[Bacta Tank]]; [[Liberty]] could not go to Used Pile).
|combos=* [[Mantellian Savrip]] + [[BG-J38]] Adds 2 to the destiny of each of your holograms and dejariks drawn for battle destiny or weapon destiny.<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Mantellian%20Savrip</ref>
* [[Mantellian Savrip]] + [[Brainiac]] [[Brainiac]]'s forfeit is equal to the total number of cards in your opponent's hand, so he often may be sacrificed to the [[Mantellian Savrip]] to cover all battle damage and attrtion against you.
